title: A rare recurring gain-of-function variant in BMPR2 causes neurodevelopmental phenotypes in humans and flies.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: Europe PMC reports no open-access full text, no PMCID, no supplement, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links to GEO/SRA/BioProject, and no Zenodo/Dryad record for the DOI. Nothing to open.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: From the abstract only: one missense variant (BMPR2 p.Glu376Lys) found in six individuals with neurodevelopmental features, plus fruit-fly experiments showing the variant is gain-of-function (overactive).

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found (checked Europe PMC, NCBI links, Zenodo/Dryad). Patient data from clinical case reports like this is usually shared only on request or via controlled access.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table exists; the result is one variant's functional effect, judged qualitatively in fly experiments. Abstract only.

a5_enough_rows.note: Six patients and one variant according to the abstract; far below the ~400-row minimum.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No download to compare against the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: The functional call is experimental (fly assays), not a model's output, but there is only one such label.

honest_claim_h3: No model claim is possible: the paper characterises one variant in six patients and deposits no data.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein sequence and variant position to predict whether a missense change makes a receptor overactive rather than broken.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need many missense variants with experimentally measured gain- or loss-of-function labels; this paper supplies one variant (6 patients). Number of usable examples: 1.
plain_idea.predict: Gain-of-function versus loss-of-function class, with the true answer coming from functional assays such as the fly experiments here.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Clinical geneticists struggle to tell overactive variants from broken ones, but this paper adds only a single labelled example, so it can't support the project.

label_elsewhere.sources: Known resources only, not searched: ClinVar and published gain-/loss-of-function variant compilations carry functional labels for other genes.
label_elsewhere.why: Gain-versus-loss labels exist elsewhere, but this paper contributes only one data point.

ml_idea: None viable from this paper: a single-variant case report with no deposited data.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; there is no dataset.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already done: Europe PMC and NCBI show no deposited data, and the abstract reports n=6 patients and 1 variant.

verdict_reason: A case report about one variant in six patients, with no deposited dataset and no table; it fails A1, A2 and A5.
